mass_calibration_basis: Inferred from the load cells, anchored at 0 kg and 1.0 kg. PROVISIONAL: supersede with a scale measurement of the physical masses (ME-2 action).
notes: Response is LINEAR in true mass. The concavity seen against the nominal labels is a load-mass labeling error, not a load-cell nonlinearity: the deviation is a function of load level only, with 0.0032 kg spread across positions against 0.0164 kg across levels. A per-cell nonlinearity would track the load each cell carries, which differs by position. It does not.
The nominal 0.25 kg mass reads ~0.28 kg on every one of its nine runs. The 0.5 kg mass reads ~0.50 kg, the 1.0 kg mass ~1.00 kg.
Zero-load run T0001 sits 8,292 counts (0.0088 kg) above the other two zero-load runs. Likely tare drift before thermal settling. It is retained in the fit; excluding it would tighten the zero anchor.
One thermal condition only (TEMP01). The twin has no temperature term and must not be used to reason about thermal drift.
Vibration off on every fitted run. Combined load plus vibration is ME-2 Stage 4, not yet collected.
Calibrated at four load levels only. true_mass() raises outside them rather than interpolating a correction it cannot support.
